 Print this article Reduce font size Increase font size . Nitanshi Goel says a good skin day can change one’s whole mood 
Long shooting hours, heavy makeup and hectic schedules have made Nitanshi Goel more conscious about taking care of her skin.
The actor, who has been exploring the world of beauty and skincare, believes that looking after one’s skin does not necessarily mean following an elaborate routine. For her, it is about understanding what the skin needs and being consistent with the basics.
 “There wasn’t really a dramatic turning point! As my schedule got busier, I realised that what I needed were a few skincare essentials and a routine I could follow anywhere. My skincare philosophy is keep it sorted, keep it consistent, and let your skin do its thing. I’ve learnt that the basics really matter — cleansing, moisturising, sunscreen and getting enough rest. Consistency matters much more to me than chasing that overnight glow,” she says.
The actor, who is the first Indian brand ambassador for a Korean skincare label, says her interest in skincare has been an enjoyable journey. “I genuinely believe a good skin day can change your whole mood! I enjoy taking care of my skin, but I like keeping my routine fuss-free. For me, skincare is less about having a hundred steps and more about finding those little things that make you feel good in your own skin. And honestly, there’s something so lovely about that fresh, healthy glow ,” she adds.
-Onkar Kulkarni, ETimes GALLERIES View more photos Aero India 2021: 13th edition of air show begins today
